lessons.claim: The check tolerance for an energy made by cancellation has to be set **against the energy scale and not against the resulting value**. The rolling resistance U = k_r R^2 (2 - (a_i-a_j).n_hat) is a cancellation of O(k_r R^2)=2.78e6 terms so the absolute residual floor is ~1e-8. ① The rigid-rotation golden test was set as |U|<1e-18*k_r and gave a false failure at U=-1.5e-8 -- the right criterion is |U|/(k_r R^2)<1e-13 (measured 5.3e-15, passing). ② Measuring the tangential-only residual of 3-point bending against k_harm gives false failures as n grows, because k_harm shrinks as 1/L^3 while the round-off floor does not (1.2e-5 at n=9, 6.2e-5 at n=15) -- measured against k_s*R^2 it is 5.3e-7 independently of n. ③ **Without giving scipy's minimization an analytic gradient**, such a cancellation energy cannot come down (U coming out negative was the sign of non-convergence).
